recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If a future issue remains with CQFM profile slicing, address it in HL7/cqf-measures rather than adding CQFM profile content to core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CQI change request asking to add a Denominator Exception slice to the CQFM Proportion Measure Profile, with vote Bryn Rhodes/Yan Heras 18-0-0 and applied-for version R5.
initial_application: The Jira application comment lists SHA 1c7262a998477f9ef6bd63d6030ccb27a6826ba9. That SHA was not found in the current HL7/fhir history, but GitHub identifies it as an HL7/cqf-measures commit by Bryn Rhodes on 2019-10-17 whose message includes GF#21184 and changes the CQFM measure profile spreadsheet.
additional_context: The current FHIR core build includes the base Measure resource and quality-reporting narrative, but no CQFM Proportion Measure profile or cqfmeasures canonical URL. Core Measure already permits denominator-exception in the population code binding, and the quality-reporting page includes Denominator Exception in proportion-measure guidance and calculation. The current HL7/cqf-measures profile source contains the denominatorException slice and a constraint allowing denominator-exception for proportion measures.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The requested artifact is external to this checkout and already contains the requested denominator-exception slice in the owning IG repository.
